title: CGBC Canonical Sermon Info Map Schema 3.0
description: Fresh-build canonical sermon knowledge contract aligned to REV5 Mapping-Amended, Scripture/Knowledge Guide v1.7, and the SPP single-pass research requirements. Version 3.0 replaces the old backfill-preservation model with source-first fresh construction while keeping sermon identity and external owner curation distinct.

localFactualRecords.description: Stage new factual records using the exact Shared Facts factualRecord definition, with status LOCAL_STAGED. The canonical evidence field for factual records is evidenceRefs; passage-level sourceEvidenceRefs is independent.

policy.const: Reviewed quote status is resolved from quote curation; canonical sermon knowledge stores only source-grounded quote evidence and UNREVIEWED research candidates.
